"""
b = argmax_(i ∈ ℝ^(2×2)) ||i||
        s.t.
        i_1,1 > 2
        i_1,1 < 3
        i_1,2 > 2
        i_1,2 < 3
        i_2,1 > 2
        i_2,1 < 3
        i_2,2 > 2
        i_2,2 < 3
        where 
        a: ℝ^3
        
"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, a):
        a = np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float64)
        assert a.shape == (3,)
        def pack(i):
            return np.concatenate([np.reshape(i, -1)])
        def unpack(X):
            return X[0:4].reshape(2, 2)
        def cons(X):
            i = unpack(X)
            return i[1-1, 1-1] - 2
        def cons_1(X):
            i = unpack(X)
            return 3 - i[1-1, 1-1]
        def cons_2(X):
            i = unpack(X)
            return i[1-1, 2-1] - 2
        def cons_3(X):
            i = unpack(X)
            return 3 - i[1-1, 2-1]
        def cons_4(X):
            i = unpack(X)
            return i[2-1, 1-1] - 2
        def cons_5(X):
            i = unpack(X)
            return 3 - i[2-1, 1-1]
        def cons_6(X):
            i = unpack(X)
            return i[2-1, 2-1] - 2
        def cons_7(X):
            i = unpack(X)
            return 3 - i[2-1, 2-1]
        cons_8 = ({'type': 'ineq', 'fun': cons}, {'type': 'ineq', 'fun': cons_1}, {'type': 'ineq', 'fun': cons_2}, {'type': 'ineq', 'fun': cons_3}, {'type': 'ineq', 'fun': cons_4}, {'type': 'ineq', 'fun': cons_5}, {'type': 'ineq', 'fun': cons_6}, {'type': 'ineq', 'fun': cons_7})
        def target(X):
            i = unpack(X)
            return -(np.linalg.norm(i, 'fro'))
        opt = minimize(target, np.zeros(4), constraints=cons_8)
        i = unpack(opt.x)
        self.b = unpack(opt.x)
        self.i = i
